source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: getMailAccounts is the shared filter used by account tracking, folder queries, identity lookup, and message queries. Centralizing the mail-account boundary prevents each API from inventing a different account set. Current code excludes im accounts there. The old source comment also mentions excluding EWS, but the actual current filter does not; trust the implementation and inspect callers when reviewing that comment.
title: Use the shared mail-account enumeration boundary across extension APIs
